      "snippet": "✅ STAGE 2 INITIATED — Canonical Reconciliation
This is the most delicate and most important stage before we build the unified OS.
Stage 2 produces:
→ a Reconciliation Table
→ a list of modules that must merge
→ a list of modules that must retire
→ and a single canonical authority for each component of the system.
This is the backbone of the entire OS.
If this stage is wrong, the unified OS will be unstable.
